question: India's first lavender festival was inaugrated in ___________ in May 2022.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jammu and Kashmir.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **India's first lavender festival** was inaugurated in **Jammu and Kashmir** in **May 2022. **
 
• The festival was organized by the **Jammu and Kashmir Tourism Department** in collaboration with **local farmers and entrepreneurs.**
 
• The aim was to promote** lavender cultivation and tourism** in the region. 
 
• The festival showcased various lavender products such as **oils, soaps, perfumes, and food items.**
 
• Visitors could also participate in workshops and activities related to** lavender farming and processing.**
 
• Jammu and Kashmir is known for its **scenic beauty and rich cultural heritage.**
 
• The state is also home to several famous tourist destinations such as **Srinagar, Gulmarg, and Leh-Ladakh.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Delhi** is the capital city of India and a major hub of **politics, business, and culture**.

 
 
• It is known for its **historical monuments, museums, markets, and food.**
 
 
 
• **Kerala** is a coastal state in southern India known for its **backwaters, beaches, and Ayurvedic treatments**.
 
 
• It is also famous for its **spices, tea, and wildlife sanctuaries.**
 
 
 
• **Assam** is a northeastern state of India known for its **tea gardens, wildlife, and silk production**.
 
 
• It is also home to several **national parks and historical sites.**
